service: api-conductores-motoRamos

provider:
  name: aws
  runtime: python3.12
  timeout: 29
  region: us-east-1
  stage: dev

  iam:
    role:
      statements:
        - Effect: Allow
          Action:
            - dynamodb:PutItem
            - dynamodb:GetItem
            - dynamodb:DeleteItem
            - dynamodb:UpdateItem
            - dynamodb:Query
            - dynamodb:Scan
          Resource:
            - "arn:aws:dynamodb:us-east-1:*:table/conductores"
            - "arn:aws:dynamodb:us-east-1:*:table/conductores/index/*"
            - "arn:aws:dynamodb:us-east-1:*:table/servicios"
            - "arn:aws:dynamodb:us-east-1:*:table/servicios/index/*"
            - "arn:aws:dynamodb:us-east-1:*:table/usuarios"
            - "arn:aws:dynamodb:us-east-1:*:table/usuarios/index/*"
        - Effect: Allow
          Action:
            - s3:PutObject
            - s3:GetObject
          Resource:
            - "arn:aws:s3:::motoramos-fotos-${self:provider.stage}/*"

  environment:
    conductoresTable: conductores
    serviciosTable: servicios
    usuariosTable: usuarios
    fotosBucket: motoramos-fotos-${self:provider.stage}
    JWT_SECRET: ${env:JWT_SECRET, 'motoRamos-tarma-jwt-secret-utec-2026'}

package:
  patterns:
    - '!node_modules/**'
    - '!.serverless/**'
    - '!venv/**'
    - '!__pycache__/**'
    - '!package-lock.json'
    - ./**

functions:
  # ── Públicos (sin JWT) ──
  RegisterConductor:
    handler: handler.registerConductor
    events:
      - http:
          path: /registerConductor
          method: post
          cors: true

  LoginConductor:
    handler: handler.loginConductor
    events:
      - http:
          path: /loginConductor
          method: post
          cors: true

  # ── Protegidos (requieren JWT) ──
  GetPerfilConductor:
    handler: handler.getPerfilConductor
    events:
      - http:
          path: /perfil
          method: get
          cors: true

  UpdatePerfilConductor:
    handler: handler.updatePerfilConductor
    events:
      - http:
          path: /perfil
          method: put
          cors: true

  GetPresignedUploadUrl:
    handler: handler.getPresignedUploadUrl
    events:
      - http:
          path: /perfil/foto-url
          method: get
          cors: true

  ToggleActivo:
    handler: handler.toggleActivo
    events:
      - http:
          path: /toggle-activo
          method: put
          cors: true

  GetHistorialConductor:
    handler: handler.getHistorialConductor
    events:
      - http:
          path: /historial
          method: get
          cors: true

  GetSolicitudesViaje:
    handler: handler.getSolicitudesViaje
    events:
      - http:
          path: /solicitudes-viaje
          method: get
          cors: true

  CalificarUsuario:
    handler: handler.calificarUsuario
    events:
      - http:
          path: /calificar
          method: post
          cors: true

  GetGananciasConductor:
    handler: handler.getGananciasConductor
    events:
      - http:
          path: /ganancias
          method: get
          cors: true
